question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Soon**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is a story of a lion.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**Soon**'.
 
• It means 'in a short time from now; a short time after something else has happened'. (अब से कुछ देर में; जल्‍दी, शीघ्र, कोई और बात हो जाने के कुछ देर बाद)
 
 
• *Example: It will **soon** be dark.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *One day, a few hunters came into the forest and took the lion with them. They tied him up against a tree. The lion was struggling to get away and started to whimper. **Soon**, a mouse walked past and noticed the lion in trouble. He quickly ran and (4) ______ on the ropes to set the lion free. Both of them then (5) ______ into the jungle.*

45:Te7b,

The correct answer is '**gnawed**'.
